# Data schema — battery-degradation-ml

This documents every dataset the pipeline reads or produces. Files marked
**(gitignored)** are not in the repo — they are downloaded or regenerated by
the scripts (see README).

---

## 1. Raw input — `MATR_*.mat` **(gitignored, ~10 GB)**

The four raw MATR batch files from data.matr.io (Severson et al., *Nature
Energy* 2019), downloaded by `download_matr.sh`. MATLAB v7.3 / HDF5 structs,
read with `h5py`. Each cell holds per-cycle summary scalars and, for every
cycle, full discharge curves on a fixed 1000-point voltage grid:

| Field (per cycle) | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Qdlin` | Discharge capacity Q(V), 1000 points on the fixed voltage grid `Vdlin` (3.5→2.0 V) |
| `discharge_dQdV` | Incremental capacity dQ/dV(V), 1000 points |
| `V`, `I`, `T`, `Qd`, `t` | Raw per-cycle traces (voltage, current, temperature, discharge capacity, time) |
| summary: `IR`, `QDischarge`, `QCharge`, `Tavg`, `Tmax`, `Tmin`, `chargetime`, `cycle` | Per-cycle scalars |
| `cycle_life` | Total cycles to end-of-life (per cell) |

180 cells total across 4 batches. 4 batch-1 cells continue into batch 2 and
are spliced back (handled in the preprocessing scripts).

---

## 2. `MATR_battery_summary.csv` **(gitignored, 14 MB)** — produced by `preprocess_matr_summary.py`

Grain: one row per **(cell, cycle)**. 154,412 rows × 8 columns.
PK = (`battery_id`, `test_id`).

| Column | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `battery_id` | string | — | Cell id, e.g. `MATR_batch1_c0` (180 unique) |
| `batch` | string | — | `batch1`–`batch4` |
| `test_id` | int | cycle | Cycle number (1–2237); the age axis |
| `ambient_temperature` | float | °C | Avg cell temp that cycle (`Tavg`); 0 = missing/formation reading |
| `Capacity` | float | Ah | Discharge capacity that cycle (`QDischarge`); nominal 1.1 Ah — the health signal |
| `Re` | float | Ω | Internal resistance (`IR`); MATR has no separate charge-transfer resistance |
| `chargetime` | float | min | Charge duration that cycle; encodes the fast-charge protocol |
| `cycle_life` | float | cycles | Total cycles to end-of-life (constant per cell); has nulls where unrecorded |

---

## 3. `MATR_augmented.csv` **(gitignored, 59 MB)** — produced by `battery_curve_features.py`

Grain: one row per **(cell, cycle)**. 154,226 rows × 25 columns. The summary
scalars **plus** per-cycle curve-shape features mined from `Qdlin`/`discharge_dQdV`.

Columns = everything in the summary table (minus `Re`/`Capacity` ordering) plus:

| Column | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QCharge` | float | Ah | Charge capacity that cycle |
| `Tmax`, `Tmin` | float | °C | Max/min temperature that cycle |
| `Qdlin_var` | float | Ah² | Variance of the Q(V) discharge curve (shape) |
| `Qdlin_min`, `Qdlin_max`, `Qdlin_range` | float | Ah | Min / max / span of the Q(V) curve |
| `Qdlin_at_{2.0,2.2,2.5,2.8,3.0,3.2,3.3}V` | float | Ah | Capacity remaining at fixed voltages |
| `dQdV_min` | float | Ah/V | Main incremental-capacity peak height (most negative) |
| `dQdV_peak_V` | float | V | Voltage of the main dQ/dV peak |
| `dQdV_var` | float | — | Variance of the dQ/dV curve |

Note: for the **SOH soft-sensor** task the absolute-capacity features
(`Qdlin_at_*V`, `Qdlin_min/max`) are deliberately excluded — only curve
*shape* features are used, so SOH is inferred from morphology, not capacity.

---

## 4. `MATR_cell_dQ_features.csv` **(in repo, 26 KB)** — produced by `battery_curve_features.py`

Grain: one row per **cell**. 180 rows × 9 columns. The Severson ΔQ(V) early-cycle
features, where ΔQ(V) = `Qdlin`[cycle 100] − `Qdlin`[cycle 10].

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `battery_id` | string | Cell id |
| `batch` | string | `batch1`–`batch4` |
| `cycle_life` | float | Total cycles to end-of-life (the prediction target for early-EOL) |
| `dQ_var_log` | float | log₁₀(variance of ΔQ(V)) — the flagship single-feature predictor (r ≈ −0.84 with log cycle life) |
| `dQ_min_log` | float | log₁₀(\|min ΔQ(V)\|) |
| `dQ_mean_log` | float | log₁₀(\|mean ΔQ(V)\|) |
| `dQ_skew` | float | Skewness of ΔQ(V) |
| `dQ_kurt` | float | Kurtosis of ΔQ(V) |
| `dQ_at_2V_log` | float | log₁₀(\|ΔQ at 2 V\|) |

---

## 5. Derived targets (computed in-memory, not stored)

- `SOH` = `Capacity` / 1.1 (nominal capacity)
- `RUL` = cycles until SOH first drops to 0.8, per cell
- `Degradation_rate`, `Capacity_diff`, etc. — within-cell, causal (trailing)

---

## 6. Result tables (in repo)

**`battery_augmented_results.csv`** — main pipeline, R² mean ± std across folds.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `Task` | `SOH`, `RUL`, or `EarlyEOL` |
| `Model` | Model name |
| `Features` | `scalar`, `scalar+curve`, `scalar+dQ` |
| `R2_mean`, `R2_std` | R² mean / std across CV folds |
| `MAE_mean`, `MAE_std` | MAE mean / std across folds |

**`battery_model_results.csv`** — original single-split bouquet.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `Task` | `SOH` or `RUL` |
| `Model` | Model name |
| `MAE`, `RMSE`, `R2` | Single 80/20 split metrics |

**`battery_insights_summary.csv`** — long-format insight metrics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `Insight` | Insight name (e.g. `early_eol`, `corr_chargetime_eol`, `knee_frac_of_life_median`) |
| `Model` | Model (for the early-EOL rows) |
| `MAE_cycles`, `R2_log`, `pct_within_15pct` | Early-EOL metrics |
| `value` | Scalar value for correlation/knee rows |
